object_description: solitary three-story volume on a flat platform
design_condition: The building follows the neighboring alignment on a flat platform, with retaining walls along the streets and external stairs linking the surrounding outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The independent solitaire with recognizable public use can assert itself in the district.
The staircase integrated into the facade harmoniously connects the outdoor spaces and relieves the internal access.
The central access is simple, clear, and generously sized.
The usage arrangement is convincing, with short paths and well-connected rooms.
The outdoor space offers varied play options and meets different requirements.
All-sided windows ensure visual connections between interior and exterior spaces and provide plenty of daylight.
The compact construction is resource-saving and economical, with low gray energy values.

negative.statement: The exposed roof terrace weakens the volume at the street corner.
The ground-floor outside staircase could be better connected to the rear outdoor space.
The architectural language sometimes appears wooden and unwieldy in context.
The disabled toilet in the basement is somewhat difficult to access.
The roof terrace weakens the solitaire's presence and moves the building visually too close to the western neighbor.
The proposed facade design is not convincing in terms of integration into the district.
